flags.reason: The guide (checked 23 October on 0.1.78-c8526ae, unchanged for Disclaimer on the installed 0.1.78-dbe0e02) says three times that copy that “doesn’t name the bank” gets “Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.” on a second line (Anatomy, Configuration, Sources). The package adds it unless the copy contains that exact string (Disclaimer.tsx line 121), so copy that names the bank another way still gets it, and longer copy gets it after its last line, not on a second one. The entry keeps the guide's words and adds the exact string from the evidence (“unless the copy already contains it”). Guide fix #531. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch10, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: The provider line under a payment action, the guide's In context: an ActionFooter titled Confirm payment holds one vertical Stack with the Pay button and, below it, the Disclaimer. The copy breaks before the bank's name, so the name stays on one line and the package adds nothing. The footer passes its modes to both, so neither sets any. The empty onPress stands for the screen's own payment handling.
examples.jsx:
<ActionFooter title="Confirm payment">
  <Stack layoutDirection="vertical">
    <Button label="Pay ₹500" onPress={() => {}} />
    <Disclaimer disclaimer={'Payment and UPI services are provided by\nJio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.'} />
  </Stack>
</ActionFooter>

from.quote: A payment footer holds the Pay button and, below it, the provider line.

examples.purpose: Terms for this screen with the full terms a link away, the guide's Content: the copy says what continuing means and the package adds “Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.” on a line below it; the full terms are on their own page, reached through a Link below the copy, because the copy can't hold links. The empty onPress stands for the screen's own navigation to that page.

props.name: disclaimer
props.default: All financial services are provided by Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.
props.description: The copy, one string; a line break is its only formatting. The package renders it, a line break, then the children if passed, else “Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.” unless the copy already contains it: “Terms apply.” renders two lines, 24 px. Declared: First line of the disclaimer text. Default "All financial services are provided by Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.", from the component source.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional style overrides for the container.

props.name: textStyle
props.description: Optional style overrides for the text element.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Replaces the spoken name. Without it the name is the copy plus the second line (“Terms apply. Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.”). On the web the root is a group with that name and the text itself is aria-hidden; on native the root is accessible with role text, so VoiceOver gets the same name (not device-tested). Declared: Accessibility label for screen readers. If not provided, uses disclaimer text.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Additional accessibility hint for screen readers /.

props.name: ...React.ComponentProps<typeof View>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection Disclaimer reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: context5
modes.description: FullscreenModal sets Fullscreen Modal on its footer Disclaimer, which makes the text #EBEBED, light grey for its dark surface, in both colour modes. Declared: A token collection Disclaimer reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
